props.text:
I've been shorting every bearish retest since 123K & done it publicly the entire way down.

My positioning was transparent, my updates consistent, and I stuck to my conviction.

Shorting from 120K all the way to 60K is more than enough, I've played this cycle better than 99% of people, and I'm fully satisfied with the gains I've made.

But you will never see me swing short $BTC down here.
↳ Public commitment to long-only going forward. Validates bear-cycle-complete thesis + group bullish convergence.
